_comment: Стили Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image) для курированных постов. Сцена + style_suffix + negative.

stern.label: Снегири / Ян Штерн
stern.style_suffix: muted natural colors, soft window light, minimalist modern apartment or home office, documentary lifestyle photography, shallow depth of field, calm mood, no neon, no gym bro aesthetic
stern.negative: text, watermark, logo, caption, neon colors, bodybuilder, crossfit poster, smiling influencer, stock photo cliché, oversaturated, cartoon, anime, visible face, portrait, selfie
stern.scene_rules: cast iron kettlebell 16kg may appear as prop; never show faces; office chair, laptop, wooden floor acceptable

gdepar.label: Где Пар? / Михалыч ↔ Кириллыч
gdepar.style_suffix: authentic Russian wooden banya interior, soft steam haze, warm amber tungsten light, documentary still life, tactile wood grain, humble not luxury spa
gdepar.negative: text, watermark, logo, neon, modern gym, swimming pool, Finnish sauna brand, faces close-up, shirtless people, cartoon
gdepar.scene_rules: no faces; focus on objects: venik, stove, stones, bucket, wooden bench, tea glass

garden.label: Сад / огород
garden.style_suffix: Central Russia dacha garden, overcast or golden hour, practical gardener aesthetic, soil and plants, documentary photo
garden.negative: text, watermark, tropical paradise, fantasy garden, faces, cartoon
garden.scene_rules: no faces; tools, seedlings, greenhouse, moon chart on paper ok

lenin.label: Ленин / революционный календарь
lenin.style_suffix: historical documentary, sepia or muted archival tone, 1900s Russia context, museum quality, respectful not propaganda poster
lenin.negative: text, watermark, modern objects, meme, cartoon, caricature, faces identifiable
lenin.scene_rules: prefer objects and wide scenes; Commons-like editorial

pension.label: Пенсия / длинные тексты
pension.style_suffix: quiet Russian provincial life, contemplative, soft overcast light, literary mood, 35mm film grain subtle
pension.negative: text, watermark, stock smile, neon, cartoon
pension.scene_rules: no faces; bench, tea, old books, window light

gdepar_classic_banya.label: Где Пар? / Классическая баня (15:00)
gdepar_classic_banya.note: 160 цитат в gdepar_classic_banya.json; портреты уже скачаны; не генерировать AI

gdepar_dir_scenes.TR: birch or oak venik on worn wooden bench, towel nearby, steam in background
gdepar_dir_scenes.TE: banya stove with smooth river stones, faint ember glow, wooden wall
gdepar_dir_scenes.NW: empty wooden sauna bench, bucket and ladle, beginner-friendly calm atmosphere
gdepar_dir_scenes.BT: banya dressing room bench, slippers, simple towel stack, everyday not spa
gdepar_dir_scenes.PS: steamy sauna interior wide angle, no people, wooden walls
gdepar_dir_scenes.MP: smartphone on wooden table showing blurred map app screen without readable text, tea glass
gdepar_dir_scenes.GN: glass mug herbal tea and water bottle on bench, steam soft
gdepar_dir_scenes.FL: old wooden banya exterior, snow or birch trees, folklore mood without people
gdepar_dir_scenes.RC: kvass or herbal tea in glass on wooden tray, banya rest room
gdepar_dir_scenes.BW: wooden bathhouse facade, weekend trip mood, car parked distant blurred
